description: GPT-5.6 Luna's loop without its checker at xhigh on tree-sitter (incremental parsing library for building syntax-aware programming tools, written in Rust): the build node alone, re-run in its own session with the task and the self-review feedback of prompts/self-review.md every round, up to 50 rounds; otherwise luna-xhigh-tree-sitter-v1's prompt, limits, resources, evaluation and prices, with round 1 differing from its build 1 by that feedback alone: 5 runs. Compared with luna-xhigh-tree-sitter-v1 and luna-xhigh-tree-sitter-worker-loop through the single GPT-5.6 Sol workers of sol-xhigh-tree-sitter-single: at the workers' mean model cost (bench parity) and by the cost to reach their mean score (bench match).

task.adjustments_rationale: The reference moves to a root-owned directory outside the workspace (the task statement points there), so builders cannot overwrite or delete it at the build target's path. This adjustment is general, not specific to the task. The bundled documentation is left as shipped: no task-specific corrections.
